tmpdir.description: Directory for temporary files created during scanning

dbdir.description: Directory containing rkhunter signature and whitelist databases

installdir.description: Base installation prefix of rkhunter (parent of bin/, share/, etc.)

logfile.description: Full path to the rkhunter log file

append_log.description: Append to the log file instead of overwriting on each run (1=append, 0=overwrite)

copy_log_on_error.description: Copy the log to TMPDIR when errors are detected (1=yes, 0=no)

lock_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a lock file to clear before aborting

show_lock_msgs.description: Print a message when a stale lock file is found at startup (1=yes, 0=no)

update_mirrors.description: Automatically download an updated mirrors list on each run (1=yes, 0=no)

mirrors_mode.description: Which mirrors to contact for database updates: 0=any, 1=local only, 2=remote only

web_cmd.description: External download command for database updates; leave empty to let rkhunter auto-detect wget or curl

mail_on_warning.description: Email address to receive warning reports; leave empty to disable email notifications

mail_cmd.description: Shell command used to deliver the warning email; rkhunter pipes the report body to its stdin

pkgmgr.description: Package manager for installed-file property verification (DPKG, RPM, NONE, etc.)

pkgmgr_no_warnings.description: Suppress package manager warnings about files absent from the package database (1=suppress, 0=show)

scan_mode_dev.description: Scan mode for /dev: THOROUGH inspects every file, LAZY skips non-device files

scanrootkitmode.description: Rootkit scan depth: THOROUGH for more complete detection, LAZY for faster runs

unhide_tests.description: Tests passed to the unhide tool: sys (syscall table), proc (/proc namespace), or 'sys proc' for both

disable_tests.description: Built-in rkhunter test names to skip on this host; reduces distro-specific false positives (e.g. suspscan, hidden_ports, packet_cap_apps)

os_version_file.description: File providing the OS distribution version string used for version-specific checks (use /etc/redhat-release on RHEL)

password_file.description: Path to the shadow/password file inspected for suspicious account entries

group_file.description: Path to the group file inspected for suspicious group entries

syslog_config_file.description: Path to the syslog daemon configuration file

startup_paths.description: Directories searched for system startup scripts

port_whitelist.description: Ports to exclude from open-port checks; each entry must be in format TCP:<port> or UDP:<port> (e.g. TCP:22)

allow_hidden_dirs.description: Hidden directories (dot-prefixed names) to allow without raising an alert; common distro paths go here

allow_hidden_files.description: Hidden files (dot-prefixed names) to allow without raising an alert

allow_dev_files.description: Files under /dev to allow without raising an alert

script_whitelist.description: Script paths exempt from world-writable and other script-based alerts

rtkt_file_whitelist.description: File paths to suppress from rootkit file-presence checks (use to silence known false positives)

rtkt_dir_whitelist.description: Directory paths to suppress from rootkit directory-presence checks

shared_lib_whitelist.description: Shared libraries allowed to appear in /etc/ld.so.preload without alerting (e.g. /lib/libsnoopy.so)

app_whitelist.description: Applications whitelisted at a specific installed version; each entry in format name:version (e.g. openssl:1.1.1)
